summary: Blocked usb-storage immediately and persistently on node1. Added modprobe blacklist/install-deny policy, rebuilt the current initramfs, rebooted node1, and verified recovery. RHEL 10.0 and kernel 6.12.0-55.9.1.el10_0 remained unchanged.
actions_performed: Applied root ownership, mode 0644, and the modules_conf_t SELinux context.
Rebuilt the installed kernel's initramfs and confirmed it contains the policy.
Verified usb_storage was unloaded and an explicit load attempt failed before reboot.
Safely rebooted node1 and confirmed its boot identity changed.
Verified system health, readable data, persisted policy, unloaded module state, and load denial after reboot.

evidence.summary: Shows the active modprobe policy, failed explicit load attempt, and that usb_storage remained unloaded.

evidence.requirement: Prevent usb-storage from loading after reboot
evidence.summary: Shows the rebuilt initramfs contains the policy and, after reboot, the policy persists, usb_storage is absent, and an explicit modprobe attempt is still denied.

evidence.requirement: Preserve installed OS release and kernel
evidence.summary: Pre- and post-reboot output both show RHEL 10.0 and kernel 6.12.0-55.9.1.el10_0.
Captures healthy baseline boot ID 6d37896c-e0cd-4fe7-acbf-94fc35781e09, safe reboot acknowledgement, changed boot ID fe4eebdc-9b6c-46e8-9358-6fca74674fbb, and recovered system/data/module state.
